variants.headline: Union calls a strike
variants.body: The union {name} has called a strike. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: A call to withhold labour
variants.body: A strike has been called by the union {name}. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Work becomes the subject of a strike call
variants.body: The union {name} has issued a call for strike action. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
